V7qA2mN8rK4xP9dL.name: Westergas
V7qA2mN8rK4xP9dL.title: THE WESTERN VAULT
V7qA2mN8rK4xP9dL.description: A hidden lock-up near the old gasworks. Look for the orange signal.
V7qA2mN8rK4xP9dL.hint: Start at the old gasworks and follow the orange signal.

H4pR8cT1nW6zQ2kM.name: Groninger Forum
H4pR8cT1nW6zQ2kM.title: NORTH SIDE STASH
H4pR8cT1nW6zQ2kM.description: The northern signal is hidden in the city rush. Follow the trail toward the square.
H4pR8cT1nW6zQ2kM.hint: Look up where the square opens wide. The next signal is above the crowd.

N9bL3xF7sD2vJ8qC.clue: Look closer. The next clue is closer than you think...
N9bL3xF7sD2vJ8qC.name: Markthal Rotterdam
N9bL3xF7sD2vJ8qC.title: THE CLOSER CLUE
N9bL3xF7sD2vJ8qC.description: A clue in the middle of the city. Keep your eyes open and move quietly.
N9bL3xF7sD2vJ8qC.hint: Start where the city gets loud. The next signal is closer than you think.

Q5mY1rU8aK3pZ6tH.name: Utrechtsebaan
Q5mY1rU8aK3pZ6tH.title: EASTERN CHECKPOINT
Q5mY1rU8aK3pZ6tH.description: A bright signal marks this lock-up. The city edge is closer than it looks.
Q5mY1rU8aK3pZ6tH.hint: A bright signal marks this lock-up. The city edge is closer than it looks.

B2kV7nC4wR9fM1xP.name: Vrijthof Maastricht
B2kV7nC4wR9fM1xP.title: THE DEEP COVER
B2kV7nC4wR9fM1xP.description: This one is tucked into the rush of the city. Stay sharp.
B2kV7nC4wR9fM1xP.hint: Find the oldest-looking corner of the square. The quietest route leads south.

L6pR2vK8mQ4xT9aN.name: Binnenhof Den Haag
L6pR2vK8mQ4xT9aN.title: THE ROYAL ROUTE
L6pR2vK8mQ4xT9aN.description: A quiet route hides in the political heart of the country.
L6pR2vK8mQ4xT9aN.hint: Find the oldest archway facing the courtyard. The signal is close to the gate.

D3nW7cH1sP5zM8qV.name: Strijp-S Eindhoven
D3nW7cH1sP5zM8qV.title: THE POWER PLANT
D3nW7cH1sP5zM8qV.description: Old factory lines lead to a bright new signal.
D3nW7cH1sP5zM8qV.hint: Start beneath the old industrial frame and follow the red brick line west.

A9fJ4rN2yK6tB8xC.name: Valkhof Nijmegen
A9fJ4rN2yK6tB8xC.title: THE HIGH GROUND
A9fJ4rN2yK6tB8xC.description: The city opens below this lookout.
A9fJ4rN2yK6tB8xC.hint: Take the path uphill until the river appears. The next clue is facing the view.

T5qL1mV7dR3pH9kS.name: Peperbus Zwolle
T5qL1mV7dR3pH9kS.title: THE NORTH WATCH
T5qL1mV7dR3pH9kS.description: A signal waits beneath the tallest old landmark.
T5qL1mV7dR3pH9kS.hint: Keep the tower behind you and search the square edge where the stones change.

G8xC2nF6wQ4aJ1zM.name: Eusebius Arnhem
G8xC2nF6wQ4aJ1zM.title: THE SKYLINE DROP
G8xC2nF6wQ4aJ1zM.description: The eastern route begins where the skyline breaks open.
G8xC2nF6wQ4aJ1zM.hint: Look toward the river side of the square. The orange mark is lower than you expect.

P4vN9kD2sL7hR5xW.name: Grote Kerk Breda
P4vN9kD2sL7hR5xW.title: THE SOUTHERN BELL
P4vN9kD2sL7hR5xW.description: A southern signal hides in the shadow of the old church.
P4vN9kD2sL7hR5xW.hint: Circle the church once. The clue points toward the narrowest street.

K1mZ6qT3bV8nC4yH.name: Piushaven Tilburg
K1mZ6qT3bV8nC4yH.title: THE WATERLINE
K1mZ6qT3bV8nC4yH.description: The trail follows the canal into the city.
K1mZ6qT3bV8nC4yH.hint: Start beside the water and follow the lamps until the path turns inland.

R7dF2pW9jA5kL3sQ.name: Oldehove Leeuwarden
R7dF2pW9jA5kL3sQ.title: THE TILTED SIGNAL
R7dF2pW9jA5kL3sQ.description: A crooked landmark points toward a straight answer.
R7dF2pW9jA5kL3sQ.hint: Stand where the tower leans. Walk toward the side it refuses to face.

Y2hM8vB4nX1cD7rK.name: Waag Leiden
Y2hM8vB4nX1cD7rK.title: THE MARKET CODE
Y2hM8vB4nX1cD7rK.description: The oldest market route still carries a fresh signal.
Y2hM8vB4nX1cD7rK.hint: Find the water behind the market. The next turn is marked by a small bridge.

C5tQ9mG2xP6wN1aV.name: Grote Markt Haarlem
C5tQ9mG2xP6wN1aV.title: THE HAARLEM HIDEOUT
C5tQ9mG2xP6wN1aV.description: A crowded square gives cover to a quiet clue.
C5tQ9mG2xP6wN1aV.hint: Face the church and take the street where the bicycles thin out.

J8rL3fS7kH2vM9pD.name: Koppelpoort Amersfoort
J8rL3fS7kH2vM9pD.title: THE DOUBLE GATE
J8rL3fS7kH2vM9pD.description: Two gates, one route, and a signal hidden between them.
J8rL3fS7kH2vM9pD.hint: Enter through the water gate. The clue waits where the two walls meet.

W4nB1qX6dT8yC3mR.name: Waagplein Alkmaar
W4nB1qX6dT8yC3mR.title: THE CHEESE ROUTE
W4nB1qX6dT8yC3mR.description: A bright square hides a route through the old town.
W4nB1qX6dT8yC3mR.hint: Start beside the old weighing house and follow the quietest canal side.

M9pK5vA2rF7xL1hQ.name: Korenmarkt Apeldoorn
M9pK5vA2rF7xL1hQ.title: THE GREEN SIGNAL
M9pK5vA2rF7xL1hQ.description: The city edge and the forest trail meet here.
M9pK5vA2rF7xL1hQ.hint: Look for the route that points away from the shops and toward the trees.

Z6cN2wJ8sD4mV9kP.name: Markt Delft
Z6cN2wJ8sD4mV9kP.title: THE BLUEPRINT
Z6cN2wJ8sD4mV9kP.description: Canals draw the lines of a hidden city blueprint.
Z6cN2wJ8sD4mV9kP.hint: Follow the canal with the oldest facades. The answer is across the first bridge.

F3yR7bQ1nH5tX8cM.name: Lange Jan Middelburg
F3yR7bQ1nH5tX8cM.title: THE WESTERN EDGE
F3yR7bQ1nH5tX8cM.description: The final western route rises above the old rooftops.
F3yR7bQ1nH5tX8cM.hint: Keep the tower in sight and take the street that leads toward the sea wind.
